claims.statement: Polish Guarantees of Origin are electronic, individually identified, transferred through a registry and confirmed on cancellation by the registry operator.
EU renewable-energy rules use Guarantees of Origin for supplier disclosure and require controlled issuance, transfer and cancellation.

contrary_evidence: Registry participants and energy brokers already perform cancellation, so the wedge depends on multi-site matching and exception cost being painful enough.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Confirmed transfers and cancellations build registry, issuer and matching-exception knowledge
fingerprint.customer: Energy suppliers, PPA advisers and multi-site companies making renewable-energy claims
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Energy brokers, PPA advisers and renewable installer channels
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Registry orchestration and auditable proof packet charged per completed retirement
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The supplier, adviser or buyer pays when cancellation is confirmed and bound to the required consumption lot
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A reporting period closes or a certificate approaches expiry and consumption must be matched and retired

founder_fit: Avoiding inventory keeps capital exposure controlled

structure.control_point: The consumption-to-certificate allocation ledger and registry cancellation confirmation
structure.critical_dependency: Authorized registry participation or partnership, plus accurate consumption and certificate-title data

thesis: For renewable-energy retailers, PPA advisers and multi-site buyers, bind metered consumption, certificate inventory and disclosure requirements, then instruct an authorized registry participant to transfer and cancel the correct Guarantees of Origin. The paid event is the regulator or registry-confirmed cancellation matched to a customer site and reporting period, not a sustainability report. Energy brokers and installers distribute the service, while confirmed retirements compound into an auditable matching and exception corpus.
title: Guarantee-of-Origin Retirement Desk
